gtcsolo.water_server.flexible: The controller can replace any wooden wall in the structure
gtcsolo.water_server.introduction.1: A continuous water supply that operates without power. Water is stored inside the controller and can be extracted from it.
gtcsolo.water_server.introduction.2: The controller can replace any wooden wall in the structure. While formed, use an empty bottle, cell, bucket or another fluid container on a wooden wall to collect water.
gtcsolo.water_server.introduction.3: Produces 500 mB/t and stores up to 200,000 mB. Breaking the structure stops generation and wall dispensing. Stored water can still be extracted from the controller.
